accountBatch.passwordChange: Signed-in own-account change, current-password check, confirmation and fresh-login requirement
accountBatch.sessionBinding: users.auth_version bound on sign-in, checked against a fresh active account on protected requests
accountBatch.recovery: Standard Laravel database password broker; single-use hashed tokens with configured 60-minute expiry; active and already verified account required
accountBatch.recoveryGate: Off by default. Only local/testing plus array mail sink can enable the recovery route logic. SMTP/log/production cannot enable it.
accountBatch.accountChanges: Password changes/resets, local-password command and sensitive staff-directory changes rotate security/remember versions and clear reset tokens; changed email loses verification
accountBatch.audit: account_access_events contains actor/origin/event, no password/reset-token values
accountBatch.executiveOverrides: Password/access changes end outstanding overrides for that account
accountBatch.existingSessionsOnUpgrade: Must sign in again; sessions without a security version are not silently adopted

dependencies: composer.json, lock and installed dependencies unchanged; no new Composer/advisory/platform check.
limits: Recovery is a disabled-by-default local mail-sink test workflow, not operational live email recovery. Verified-address onboarding, invitations and MFA still require the actual identity/delivery integration.
SQLite and local HTTP only; no current MySQL/MariaDB or Cloud deployment test.
No browser/mobile/keyboard/physical-print acceptance or full production penetration/timing-uniformity assessment.
Installing this batch requires the additive migration and an intentional fresh sign-in for existing sessions. Do not bypass the version check to retain old sessions.
